groups.architect_note: One owner per small rule: plan_step owns "the step covering now" with its end rule; water heat capacity, naive-instant zone and the finite test get one definition; accuracy.py stops carrying the Home Assistant import to five pure modules. Refused shapes: two bodies folded under one function with nothing shared, and a helper handed a detector's list.
